name: Tāmaki Road Board offices, St Heliers
description:
1929
Looking north along St Heliers Bay Road from Polygon Road, circa 1929. The Tāmaki Road Board offices, now St Heliers Library, are on the right. Photographer unknown. Auckland Libraries Heritage Collections 589-0259. No known copyright restrictions.

St Heliers Library and the view towards the bay on 11 November 2026. Photograph by Boris.
